Branch only accepts a bare provider name as the model string, so it is effectively unreachable/buggy.

rule 8: LangChain initChatModel(model, {modelProvider}) construction used by all three retrieval_graph nodes; 'provider/model' comes from configurable.queryModel (default 'openai/gpt-4o', frontend sends 'openai/gpt-4o-mini'), both catalog ids; default OpenAI endpoint, key from env. Provider allow-list also includes non-OpenAI vendors, but every value the repo configures is openai.
